primitives.cheapest_falsifier: protected complete useful wall time does not improve against the same resident control, with identical output and zero fallback
primitives.fundamental_physical_idea: keep executable state and reusable bindings alive across token steps
primitives.invariant: when state and bindings remain valid, repeated host entry is not semantically required
primitives.name: PersistentPhysicalRegion

residency.weights is resident
residency.state is sequence-scoped
bindings remain valid across token steps

primitives.cheapest_falsifier: packed resident A/B has no protected complete-wall benefit or violates the no-dense-rematerialization/capability gate
primitives.fundamental_physical_idea: spend residency and local storage to avoid repeatedly moving the dominant operand
primitives.invariant: the best stationary operand is the one whose reuse exceeds the cost of retaining it
primitives.name: StationaryRepresentation
preconditions: representation is packed_native at the occupying tier
residency carries an explicit stationarity_contract
memory tier is a component of executable identity
the operand is not also declared REMOTE (REMOTE is movement)

primitives.atlas_entry: absent; technique coverage folds prefetch into async_double_buffer
primitives.cheapest_falsifier: the prefetch destination is still in use when the consumer starts, or a protected complete wall does not improve after the copy/fence cost

cost_removed.mechanism: hide independent movement behind compute without requiring two owned buffers

primitives.fundamental_physical_idea: stage the next operand asynchronously; one-sided overlap, not dual-buffer ownership
primitives.invariant: a prefetch is legal only when the destination is not in use by the consumer and the source remains valid until the copy completes
primitives.name: AsyncPrefetch
preconditions: source remains valid until the copy completes
destination is not concurrently consumed
overlap is a measured window, not an assumed one
Fusion ISA PREFETCH is a timeline hint, not this primitive

primitives.cheapest_falsifier: measured overlap window is zero or protected complete wall is not lower after fence costs
primitives.fundamental_physical_idea: overlap independent movement and compute with two ownership-safe buffers
primitives.invariant: a transfer can be hidden only inside a real overlap window with explicit producer/consumer ownership
primitives.name: DoubleBufferedTile
preconditions: two ownership-safe buffers exist at the occupying tier
producer/consumer fences are explicit
overlap is measured, not assumed

primitives.cheapest_falsifier: fused region fails numerical parity or protected complete wall increases after local-storage/fence cost

cost_removed.mechanism: fuse producer-consumer regions and keep intermediates local

primitives.fundamental_physical_idea: make locality and pipeline ownership explicit in the graph
primitives.invariant: if an intermediate is not externally observable, its global materialization is optional
primitives.name: SpatialPipeline
preconditions: producer-consumer chain is placed as spatial regions
intermediates are not observable outside the region
semantic edges name payload, owner, and order

primitives.atlas_status_note: PHYSICALLY_MEASURED is the atlas/Codex evidence class, not a sidecar measurement. This module emits CONTRACT_ONLY / STATIC_ONLY.
primitives.cheapest_falsifier: parity, fallback, or protected complete-wall gate fails against the same-source dense/control path

cost_removed.mechanism: remove dense rematerialization and its write/read

primitives.fundamental_physical_idea: fuse representation decode with arithmetic at the consumer
primitives.invariant: a representation-native consumer may remove an intermediate only when its numerical contract is preserved
primitives.name: FusedDecodeCompute
preconditions: consumer is representation-native (no dense rematerialization)
numerical contract of the unfused path is preserved
decode happens at the occupying tier, not via a host round-trip

primitives.cheapest_falsifier: selected-route protected complete wall does not beat current Flash control after route/gather/accumulate costs

cost_removed.mechanism: skip inactive experts and eliminate staging copies

primitives.fundamental_physical_idea: treat routing and accumulation as one physical region around selected payloads
primitives.invariant: for few active tokens, route metadata and selected payload locality matter more than nominal expert throughput
primitives.name: DirectRoutedAccumulate
preconditions: route metadata is resident at the occupying tier
payloads are the selected subset only
accumulate is in the same physical region as the selected experts

primitives.cheapest_falsifier: device-resident state does not improve protected complete wall or fails checkpoint/bisection parity

cost_removed.mechanism: keep mutable sequence state resident and ordered

primitives.fundamental_physical_idea: model decode as a state machine rather than reconstructing stateless operators every step
primitives.invariant: mutable state has one authoritative owner and its update ordering is part of the executable identity
primitives.name: LocalStateMachine
preconditions: exactly one authoritative resident owner for the state
state-update edges are explicit in the graph
update ordering is part of physical identity

primitives.cheapest_falsifier: semantic edge accounting cannot reproduce the reference output or link cost erases the proposed benefit

cost_removed.mechanism: avoid untyped copies and choose topology-aware movement

primitives.fundamental_physical_idea: make data movement a semantic graph edge instead of an opaque memory copy
primitives.invariant: a transfer is optimizable only when its payload, owner, ordering, and reduction semantics are explicit
primitives.name: SemanticTransportEdge
preconditions: edges are typed (activation / state / compact_representation / partial_reduction)
owner and order are declared
the copy is not an opaque memcpy

primitives.atlas_entry: absent; technique coverage files tiled GEMV/GEMM under layout_algebra
primitives.cheapest_falsifier: tiled result disagrees with the untiled projection, or a protected complete wall does not improve after tile/fence cost

cost_removed.mechanism: execute the projection as owned tiles rather than a whole-operand round-trip

primitives.fundamental_physical_idea: the projection operator itself is tiled; layout algebra (LayoutTransform) chooses packing, this primitive is the tiled operator

primitives.name: TiledProjection
preconditions: tile ownership covers the logical result
layout (LayoutTransform) is already chosen or is the identity layout
numerical contract of the untiled projection is preserved

primitives.cheapest_falsifier: same-source protected A/B at the chosen organ shows no complete-wall or active-byte benefit

cost_removed.mechanism: reduce strided movement and tails through shape-aware mapping

primitives.fundamental_physical_idea: choose layout and thread/tile ownership as compiler objects rather than kernel folklore
primitives.invariant: the same logical operation may have materially different movement and reduction costs under different legal layouts
primitives.name: LayoutTransform
preconditions: logical, physical, tile, lane, and arithmetic mappings are distinct compiler objects
nominal utilization is not authority
the transform is a legal layout of the same logical tensor

primitives.cheapest_falsifier: sparse control does not preserve output or its index/branch overhead exceeds the omitted work in protected complete wall
primitives.fundamental_physical_idea: make conditional work explicit in the physical program and pay only for selected operands
primitives.invariant: skipping is legal only when the omitted contribution is proven zero or outside the selected computation
primitives.name: SparseSkip
preconditions: omitted contribution is proven zero or unselected
index/branch overhead is accounted in the complete wall
output ordering and numerical semantics are preserved
